description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for configuring and resolving browser profiles and settings within a larger project, including handling of CDP ports, URLs, profiles, and SSR policies.

methods.name: normalizeHexColor
methods.description: Normalizes a hex color string, defaulting if invalid.

methods.name: normalizeTimeoutMs
methods.description: Normalizes timeout values, applying fallback if necessary.

methods.name: resolveCdpPortRangeStart
methods.description: Resolves the starting port for CDP port range, validating bounds.

methods.name: normalizeStringList
methods.description: Normalizes a list of strings, trimming and filtering empty entries.

methods.name: resolveBrowserSsrFPolicy
methods.description: Resolves SSR fallback policy based on browser config.

methods.name: parseHttpUrl
methods.description: Parses and validates an HTTP or WebSocket URL.

methods.name: ensureDefaultProfile
methods.description: Ensures the default 'openclaw' profile exists in profiles map.

methods.name: ensureDefaultUserBrowserProfile
methods.description: Ensures a default 'user' profile exists for Chrome's attach flow.

methods.name: resolveBrowserConfig
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes the browser configuration into a structured object.

methods.name: resolveProfile
methods.description: Resolves a specific profile by name, returning its connection details.

methods.name: shouldStartLocalBrowserServer
methods.description: Indicates whether to start a local browser server (always true).
